bodies.name: Gelid (WIP)
bodies.notes: Black, frozen surface over a liquid ocean kilometers deep. Rimelight runs a station here.

bodies.name: Rime (WIP)
bodies.notes: Seams under the ice larger than anything in the inner Basin, clustered around the heat engine. Rimelight runs two stations here.

bodies.name: Cistern (WIP)
bodies.notes: The largest of the Hollows, with the deepest ocean. Rimelight runs a station here.

bodies.name: Sump (WIP)
bodies.notes: Site of the Rimelight station lost to the Unlit.

bodies.name: Coldharbour (WIP)
bodies.notes: Unworked; Rimelight has filed claims but not landed.

bodies.name: Hoar (WIP)
bodies.notes: An unworked rogue world on the far side of the Hollows.

bodies.name: Floe (WIP)
bodies.notes: A small rogue world, rarely visited.
bodies.gmNotes: The Unlit use Floe as a staging point between the Mire's tidal lane and the rest of the Hollows.

bodies.name: Sable mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 10-day lane to Sable (one way, inward to here).

bodies.name: Tarn mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 6-day lane to Tarn (one way, outward from here). The only way out of the Hollows.

bodies.name: Mire mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the 5-day lane to the Mire (tidal: open about two weeks in every seventy-three days).

places.notes: Absent heat engine beneath the ice, keeping the ocean below liquid. Nobody has managed to switch one off or explain it. The richest lattice seams cluster around it.
